outcomeEvent.correctionPolicy: Append a new event with supersedes_outcome_id; never mutate the old event.

routeDecision.relationship: Exactly one saved decision per accepted outcome event.

transactionGuarantees: Outcome event and RouteDecision commit together.
A repeated idempotency key returns the same event and decision.
Concurrent requests with the same idempotency scope cannot create duplicates.
Production without a configured PostgreSQL repository returns STORAGE_UNCONFIGURED.
correctionRules: A correction before downstream consumption creates a superseding event and a new decision.
If the prior decision already created or started a downstream live instance, reject automatic correction with 409 OUTCOME_ALREADY_CONSUMED.
Never delete downstream instances or history automatically.
migrationBoundary: A local migration may be added only if the current schema cannot represent these logical records. Do not apply production migrations in this iteration.
